what: The hero art panels gather and assemble. The small ball (lead) in the center group, moved to the exact middle of the panel, floats up from 100% below in .5s power1.inOut. At 1.6s the figure in the group enters from the bottom right at 58vw · 58vh in .8s power1.out. At 2.4s the group moves into place in .8s power2.out, while at the same time the left cluster gathers from −50vw · 50vh and the right cluster from 50vw · 50vh in 1.2s power2.out (.15s stagger). At 1s · 2.4s · 3s · the end, the fx:gather-play · header · bg · end signals fire to switch on the header and background. When it ends, as the panel scrolls past the screen (scrub 1), the group scatters to the bottom right (100vw · 50vh · 1.1x) and the side clusters scatter to their own bottom side (∓100vw · 50vh · 1.2x).

options.[data-fx-part=lead]: What floats up first inside the center group (ball, logo) — if absent, the whole group moves to center
options.[data-fx-part=figure]: Person who enters at 1.6s within the center group
options.pace: Multiplier for all timings and durations, default 1 — for apps whose screens open often, reduce it to something like .5
options.scatter: If false, no scroll scatter is applied after it finishes

note: The original blocks page scroll during the entrance (body overflow hidden) and releases it at fx:gather-bg — whether to block is decided by the consumer through a signal
